theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (H : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (L : NNReal) (m : ℝ) (w : Euclid n → ℕ) (ζ : Euclid n → MultiVector P n), IsOpen U → LipschitzWith L H → MeasurableSet B → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ B, ∀ a' ∈ B, m * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖H a - H a'‖) → (∀ a ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ H a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ H a)) → H '' B ⊆ U → Measurable w → (∀ a ∈ B, 1 ≤ w a) → AEStronglyMeasurable ζ (volume.restrict B) → (∀ᵐ a ∂(volume.restrict B), ∃ s : ℝ, (s = 1 ∨ s = -1) ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ζ a α = s * α (fun j => fderiv ℝ H a (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))) → ∫⁻ a in B, (w a : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (((fderiv ℝ H a).adjoint ∘L fderiv ℝ H a).det)) ∂volume ≠ ∞ → ∃ R : IMRep U n, R.measure U = ∫⁻ a in B, (w a : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (((fderiv ℝ H a).adjoint ∘L fderiv ℝ H a).det)) ∂volume ∧ ∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, R.action ω = ∫ a in B, (w a : ℝ) * ζ a (ω (H a)) ∂volume
